description: Implement the Supabase Edge Function for generating and emailing height measurement reports as PDF. Follows the exact pattern from supabase/functions/send-health-report-email/index.ts - uses jsPDF for PDF generation and Resend API for email delivery.
steps: Create supabase/functions/send-height-report-email/index.ts - Edge Function that: (a) Authenticates user via requireUser from _shared/common.ts, (b) Accepts body with measurements array (each with method, value_cm, timestamp), median, average, accuracy_mode boolean, (c) Builds a PDF using jsPDF showing: title 'Height Measurement Report', user name, date, measurement method(s), individual readings (if accuracy mode), median value, average value, final determined height, (d) Sends email via Resend API with PDF attachment using same sendEmailWithAttachment pattern from send-health-report-email, (e) Returns { success: true, email: recipient }. Follow the exact patterns from supabase/functions/send-health-report-email/index.ts for PDF generation and email sending.

Update lib/services/height_measurement_service.dart to add the sendHeightReport method that calls the 'send-height-report-email' edge function with the measurement data. Follow the pattern from lib/services/report_service.dart (sendReportToEmail method).
acceptance_criteria: supabase/functions/send-height-report-email/index.ts exists and follows the Deno.serve + invoke pattern from _shared/common.ts
The edge function generates a PDF with jsPDF containing height measurement data
The edge function sends email via Resend API with PDF attachment
The edge function accepts: measurements array, median, average, accuracy_mode flag
lib/services/height_measurement_service.dart has sendHeightReport method that invokes the edge function
PDF shows individual readings, median, average when accuracy mode is used
verification: Verify the function uses jsPDF and Resend API following the same pattern as send-health-report-email
Verify the Flutter service method matches the report_service.dart pattern for edge function calls
